criteria.primary: Positive ON-OFF score difference, CI95 lower bound >0 and paired sign-test p<0.05 on seed2000.

criteria.regressions: Inspect matched nine-task likelihood comparison and all per-task changes before recommending any candidate; report inconclusive uncertainty honestly.
criteria.truncation: Report ON/OFF truncation rates and token counts; never interpret shorter answers alone as quality.
criteria.export: Recheck actual student/patch quality, canonical lineage, reconstructed tensors and loaded-logit equivalence.
criteria.limitations: This is a local math confirmation and likelihood regression plan, not the complete official18-task league score. Never claim an overall official win from this subset.

failure_rule: No submission for a negative/inconclusive result. Once confirmation is inspected it is no longer an untouched holdout; any further tuning needs a newly predeclared independent confirmation plan.
